title: Profile
description: <.jad>/profiles/<category>/<name>.json. The profile name is the file name. A profile picks a prompt, the models it may use, one toolset and setting overrides.

instructions.description: System-prompt text placed before the prompt documents, in the prompt_role. It is the profile's, so every model the profile offers gets it. A model file may not carry instructions.

models.description: Narrows the models. Items: "<category>" for a whole folder, "<category>/<name>" for one file, or "*". A missing key offers every model; [] offers none. An item that matches no model is a load error.

model_default.description: Model used when a request names none, written <category>/<name>, for example "openai/gpt-deep". Must be one of the profile's models. Without it, the first of them (by ID) is used.

toolset.description: The toolset this profile uses, written <category>/<name> under tools/, for example "coding/full". Any toolset may be used. Without it the profile has no native tool and no MCP tool.

tools.description: Which registered tools the profile's model sees. allow lists them, deny takes some away and wins over allow; without allow every registered tool is shown except what deny names. deny also limits the profile's sub-agents. Each entry is a native tool name, mcp:<server>:<tool> or mcp:<server>:*; setting.schema.json has the full rules.

settings.description: Overrides of the setting keys listed in propertyNames. Objects merge key by key with the level above; arrays and scalars replace it. Each value follows the same key in setting.schema.json.
